review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for `map_appLE`/`comp_appLE` (the grep returned nothing; the names are used only through `Scheme.Hom.*`). The file has no simp attributes at all. Its main theorem is a one-off, so most of the manual rewriting I saw is not a simp-interface defect. The only case with real evidence is `top_le_preimage_iff`, which is used by hand six times as `(top_le_preimage_iff _ _).1/.2`. Because I cannot run Lean, I do not know whether simp would pick the basicOpen lemma over the general one. I also did not check whether the lemma is unsuitable as a global simp lemma in a wider project, since it is stated for a specific Spec ℂ source. I rejected `val_map` as a simp candidate because its hypothesis `h'` does not occur in the LHS, so simp could not discharge it. I rejected `val_fromSpec` because it is only ever rewritten with an explicit `hU`. I did not file either as a finding.

findings.excerpt:
theorem top_le_preimage_iff {Y : Scheme.{0}} (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ) ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ⊤ ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U ↔ q.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ) ∈ U
findings.problem: The canonical way to turn `⊤ ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U` (a map from Spec ℂ) into a statement about the closed point is the iff `top_le_preimage_iff`. It is used only through manual term-mode applications such as `(top_le_preimage_iff _ _).1 hw₀`, `(top_le_preimage_iff _ _).2 hx₀b` and `(top_le_preimage_iff _ _).1 hwb'`, six times in `solution` (lines 90, 91, 93, 100, 101), plus one `rw` inside `top_le_preimage_basicOpen_iff` (line 45). Both iff lemmas carry no `@[simp]` attribute and no stated normal form. The two lemmas also overlap. The LHS of `top_le_preimage_basicOpen_iff` is a special case of `top_le_preimage_iff` with `U := M.basicOpen b`. If someone made only the general lemma `@[simp]`, simp could rewrite the basicOpen goal to a membership in `q.base closedPoint` and miss the intended normal form `σ b ≠ 0`. The file leaves it unspecified which rule wins. I could not run Lean, so I do not claim to have observed this.
findings.proposed_change: Choose one normal form and encode it. Keep `top_le_preimage_basicOpen_iff` as the more specific rule, tagged `@[simp]` (or with higher priority) so `⊤ ≤ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ) ≫ hU.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ M.basicOpen b` becomes `σ b ≠ 0`. Make `top_le_preimage_iff` a `@[simp]` lemma for the general case, or a plain `rw`/`simp only` lemma if the specific one must stay unambiguous. Then `hx₀U'`, `hx₀U`, `hb0`, `hwb'` and `hwU'` can be written as `simpa using` / `simp only [top_le_preimage_iff]` calls instead of chains of `(…).1/.2`. The same simp set would also remove the extra `simp` in `hpU` (line 81).
findings.benefit: The specific-before-general ordering is settled in one place. The membership/closed-point reformulation of `⊤ ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U` becomes available to simp, so downstream users need no repeated `(top_le_preimage_iff _ _).1/.2`. The intended normal form `σ b ≠ 0` is no longer at risk of being pre-empted by the general rule.
